summary: Diff adds optional geolocation to the backend report type, provides a migration initializing the new field to null, adds a frontend geolocation hook, conditionally displays geolocation in report detail, and adds latitude/longitude columns to CSV export. However, the diff summary does not provide clear evidence that the report creation flow actually accepts/persists submitted geolocation end-to-end (backend createReport storage and frontend submit payload).

missing_requirements.requirement: createReport stores the submitted geolocation (when provided) and continues to set createdBy to the caller as it does today.
missing_requirements.reason: backend/main.mo shows the DailyServiceReport type extended with geolocation, but the provided truncation does not include any createReport logic demonstrating that geolocation is accepted in the input and persisted, nor that createdBy behavior is preserved.

missing_requirements.requirement: When location capture succeeds, the submitted report includes the captured latitude/longitude (and any additional captured fields) sent to the backend via useCreateReport.
missing_requirements.reason: ReportEntryPage.tsx shows useGeolocation is imported/used and a report object is constructed, but the truncated snippet does not show geolocation being attached to the report payload passed to useCreateReport.

hallucinated_features.description: Adds a Google Maps link in the ReportDetailPage geolocation section.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-4 only asks to display captured geolocation on viewing surfaces; a Google Maps link is an extra behavior not requested in the BuildRequest.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt ("ReportDetailPage.tsx": "...conditional geolocation section displaying coordinates with Google Maps link...")
